subsystems.name: Corpus ingestion
subsystems.role: builds the raw record of what is being researched, patented, funded and hired for.

subsystems.name: Entity resolution and taxonomy
subsystems.role: turns messy names into stable things — one organisation, one technology, one concept.

subsystems.name: Signal detection
subsystems.role: finds weak, early traces before they become obvious.

subsystems.name: Forecasting models
subsystems.role: extrapolates each signal into a dated expectation with uncertainty.

subsystems.name: Evaluation harness
subsystems.role: the part that keeps the system honest.

subsystems.name: Analyst interface
subsystems.role: presents a forecast with its evidence, not just a number.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the corpora
buildSteps.detail: Pull decades of patents, papers, grants, job ads and product announcements, with licence terms recorded per source so the training data can legally be used.

buildSteps.title: Normalise and deduplicate
buildSteps.detail: Resolve 'who' and 'what' consistently: merge spelling variants, split namesakes, and map free text onto a controlled taxonomy of technologies.

buildSteps.title: Build the signals
buildSteps.detail: Convert the corpus into time series — new entrants per field, citation velocity, co-authorship between previously separate fields, hiring shifts — each timestamped so nothing seen later leaks into earlier predictions.

buildSteps.title: Detect emergence
buildSteps.detail: Flag clusters that are growing faster than their field's baseline, and, more importantly, clusters forming at the boundary between two fields, which is where genuinely new capabilities usually appear.

buildSteps.title: Fit forecasting models
buildSteps.detail: Train models to map an early signal pattern to a later outcome — shipped product, commercial deployment, or fade-out — using only information available at the time of the prediction.

buildSteps.title: Backtest honestly
buildSteps.detail: Re-run the system as if standing in past years and score its forecasts against what actually happened, including the predictions it never made and the ones that quietly failed.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate uncertainty
buildSteps.detail: Adjust stated confidence so that '70% likely' events really do occur about 70% of the time, and refuse to output a point estimate without a range and a date.

buildSteps.title: Wrap in an agent loop
buildSteps.detail: Give the model tools to retrieve evidence, follow citations and check its own claims, so every forecast can be traced back to the records that produced it.

buildSteps.title: Deploy with human review
buildSteps.detail: Analysts triage outputs, record where the system was wrong, and those judgements feed back into the taxonomy and the calibration layer.

prerequisites.tech: Large machine-readable corpora of research and patents
prerequisites.why: forecasting needs decades of dated records, and much historical text is still paywalled or un-digitised.
they supply the embeddings and concept extraction that make cross-domain similarity searchable.
the structure of who-cites-whom and who-works-with-whom carries much of the early signal.

prerequisites.tech: Labelled datasets of technology emergence and failure
prerequisites.why: no large, unbiased record exists of which early signals actually led to deployed technology; without it, models are tuned on anecdotes.

prerequisites.tech: Methods to separate substance from hype
prerequisites.why: publication and funding counts rise with fashion as well as with real progress, and current models cannot reliably tell the two apart.

pathway.milestone: retrieval-and-summarise assistants over patent and literature databases
pathway.unlocks: faster expert scanning, with the model as a search tool rather than an oracle.

pathway.milestone: calibrated short-horizon forecasts (roughly 1–3 years) that are backtested and published with their error rates
pathway.unlocks: usable early warning for research funders and engineering teams.

pathway.milestone: shared benchmark suites and open hindcasting for technology forecasting
pathway.unlocks: comparable claims, and honest measurement of what machine forecasting can and cannot do.

pathway.milestone: combining text signals with cost, materials and manufacturing constraints
pathway.unlocks: forecasts that account for whether something can actually be built and shipped, not merely published.

pathway.milestone: audited decision-support systems in research and industrial strategy
pathway.unlocks: portfolio choices informed by evidence — provided the limits of prediction are stated up front.
